Messages.Author: Boon Sian Chang
Messages.Body:
Can allies take actions the turn they are recruited? I tried to find this in the
rulebook, but was unable to locate it anywhere.

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Boon Sian Chang wrote:
>
> Can allies take actions the turn they are recruited? I tried to find this in the
> rulebook, but was unable to locate it anywhere.

No. Allies are recruited and placed in the inactive region.
They do not move to the active region until the end of the
turn (the influence phase). They cannot take actions from the
inactive region.

6.4:
"An ally cannot take an action on the turn he is recruited. When the ally is
brought into play, he is placed in your inactive region to indicate that he
cannot act. At the end of your turn, allies in your inactive region are
moved to your active region."
